definitionZh: :-moz-user-disable CSS伪类是一个Mozilla扩展,匹配代表未加载的图像的元素,因为图像已被用户的偏好完全禁用.
sourceDefinition: The :-moz-user-disabled CSS pseudo-class is a Mozilla extension that matches elements representing images that were not loaded because images have been entirely disabled by the user's preferences.
